title: MCP: install the ComfyUI engine, models and Flows from an outside agent
description:
Outside agents on MCP (routes/mcp.js) have no install tool at all (header: 'none that installs'); Cosmo has install_model only, behind an in-app Yes/No card (agentLoop.mjs install_model), and refuses Flows with IS_A_FLOW. Fabio 2026-10-13: an MCP agent should be able to set a user up end to end.

Add three MCP tools, each a thin call to an existing route, each answering with size + target folder and doing nothing until resent with a confirm flag (same shape as the CONFIRM_COST spend gate; never confirm for the user):
- install_engine -> POST /engine/download (routes/engine.js). Needs modelsRoot: ask the user or use the default, never pick silently. It stops the running ComfyUI, so refuse while generations are queued. Progress: engine:* events / engine status.
- install_model -> POST /connector/install (routes/connector.js), already on the HTTP API.
- install_flow -> download the Flow's missing models (the Flow Library 'Get models' path, downloadService.start()). 'Licence required' (Hugging Face access grant) and paid 'Get it' Flows cannot be done by an agent: return a code that tells the user the errand.
Each install shows itself in the app (queue/download row, every end visible). Update the MCP tool list docs, the .mcpb bridge if it lists tools, and the cubric-studio skill. Open question: does Cosmo get install_flow + install_engine too (in-app confirm card)?
